title: Yara and the Uniform
author: Sable Amberdale
blurb: Yara Crane, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
